cases.title: Identity closure
cases.positive: Source, decoder/runtime, projection, authority and logical-release identities are exact and mutually bound.
cases.hostile: Alter one determinant; the selected path refuses or produces a distinct identity with explained lineage.

cases.title: Authority without inference
cases.positive: Every semantic/routing/design premise comes from competent exact authority.
cases.hostile: A missing premise remains missing; label equality, numeric equality and compiler defaults cannot substitute.

cases.title: Epistemic-class succession
cases.positive: Mechanical succession preserves manual, derived, precedent, unresolved, review and prohibited classes.
cases.hostile: A recovered old artifact cannot become current without its exact succession disposition.

cases.title: Encoding boundary
cases.positive: D01 recognizes only its exact source/encoding contract and preserves governed values.
cases.hostile: Unknown SHA, malformed text and absent encoding declaration cannot trigger a global permissive fallback.

cases.title: Opaque date/text
cases.positive: D02 preserves the declared physical identity of opaque date/text carriers.
cases.hostile: Coercion, timezone/date reinterpretation or lost typed value is detected.

cases.title: Numeric key law
cases.positive: G01 operates only under the accepted value-key equivalence law.
cases.hostile: Do not collapse distinct types/values globally merely to make joins pass.

cases.title: Bidirectional conditional arithmetic
cases.positive: Use one common risk set, exhaustive partition and consistent measure; compute both directions from exact joint evidence.
cases.hostile: Proposed fixture: P1 has yes=54/no=6, P2 yes=8/no=32. P(yes|P1)=54/60; P(P1|yes)=54/62. These are fixture expectations, not survey findings or a universal model law.

cases.title: Attitude and joint conditioning
cases.positive: Attitude-to-attitude and known-configuration-to-remaining-target queries preserve exact conditioners and support.
cases.hostile: A condition change must change the query identity; incompatible risk/measure contexts refuse composition.

cases.title: Higher-order signal
cases.positive: XOR/parity and equal-marginal/different-joint fixtures survive discovery and consumer use.
cases.hostile: No pairwise or marginal shortcut may erase an existing higher-order configuration.

cases.title: Minority/counterpattern survival
cases.positive: Supported minority, contradictory and counterpattern branches survive the composed path.
cases.hostile: Ranking or majority selection cannot silently delete supported alternatives; underpowered remains distinct.

cases.title: Recursive ancestry
cases.positive: At least secondary/depth-two consumption retains parent predicates, exact cohort/risk identity and support.
cases.hostile: Child predicates with lookalike text but different lineage cannot alias; unvisited branches remain explicitly unvisited.

cases.title: S14 absence without co-travel loss
cases.positive: Lawful empirical co-travel reaches the consumer when special semantic-relation authority is absent.
cases.hostile: Only the specific semantic interpretation is blocked; empirical configuration evidence remains available.

cases.title: Joint morphology and component scope
cases.positive: Source-native ordering, ranked/multiselect or other governed non-scalar configuration survives.
cases.hostile: A missing component vector or heterogeneous authority cannot be scalarized or silently assigned universal J2I roles.

cases.title: Negative-state conservation
cases.positive: Zero, valid-empty, underpowered, unknown, unresolved, unvisited, noncomparable, blocked and integrity failure remain distinguishable at the final consumer.
cases.hostile: Positive-only recursive handoffs must be accompanied by access to the full negative/coverage record.

cases.title: Direct-route legitimacy
cases.positive: A competent direct producer can be consumed when its contract suffices.
cases.hostile: A failed learned claim cannot be relabeled DIRECT_PRODUCER to bypass its required rule.

cases.title: Final-consumer witness
cases.positive: Actual producer output is consumed by a named current consumer using the public path.
cases.hostile: Handmade final output or schema construction alone does not prove producer-to-consumer composition.

cases.title: Computed possibility slices
cases.positive: A provider computes slice evidence from exact empirical products and feeds the possibility primitive.
cases.hostile: Handwritten 60/40 fixture slices qualify a consumer primitive, not the empirical provider.

cases.title: Replay grade
cases.positive: Every replay claim names its grade and demonstrates it in a fresh process where promised.
cases.hostile: HISTORICAL_EXPLANATION_ONLY cannot be reported as fresh empirical recomputation.

cases.title: Selective invalidation
cases.positive: One exact determinant mutation reaches all and only registered affected products, with replacement or NO_CURRENT.
cases.hostile: A missing cross-owner dependency is a failed closure witness; cache contents cannot restore authority.

cases.title: Coverage conservation
cases.positive: All 35 source identities and every demanded edge/function cell are accounted for; inherited generic proof is explicit.
cases.hostile: Do not drop difficult sources, replace the census with an unperformed rerun or call two canaries universal proof.
